finding: Ordinary-driving and finite crew/movement admission checked alive and canMove but did not inspect the native water-damaged engine flag.
implementation: Refuse new ordinary-driving/crew/bypass/corridor movement for waterDamaged vehicles. Shared convoy bypass/corridor mobility checks also exclude drowned engines. Leave existing movement ownership and cap/operation cleanup independent of the health check; no repair, damage reset, immunity, new worker, scan or timer.
sourceScope: Native command describes an engine water-damage flag after drowning. No claim that canMove always remains true, or that an observed audit failure was caused by drowning.
notImplemented: No shallow-ford policy, depth calculation or water-crossing permission. Existing dry/static-deck geometry remains required.
limitations: No measured runtime performance or physical damage/repair transition proof. Unsigned dirty development candidate includes preserved unrelated dirt; engineering notes postdate package.
